active_rights_sparse_revenue_review.behavior: 版权仍有效但收入信号稀疏或陈旧时，进入复核桶，不继续归为 unknown_shelf_status，不直接判下架。

expired_with_tail_revenue_review.behavior: 版权到期且近 12 月仍有收入时，保持 rights_expired_likely_off_shelf，同时输出复核提示，不覆盖版权台账。

unknownShelfStatusChange.remainingReason: 剩余 unknown 主要由版权到期缺失导致，仍需补数据或 formal waiver。

testCoverage: active rights with sparse or stale revenue enters review bucket instead of unknown
expired rights with tail revenue follows trusted copyright ledger status and emits review prompt
zero revenue alone does not infer off shelf
no explicit shelf or work status does not fabricate confident on-shelf status
shelf review bucket does not change revenue classifier or rating modules

blockers: 610 个版权到期缺口仍未补齐或 formal waiver。
分类、标签、作品状态、音频版权状态仍未闭环。
active_rights_sparse_revenue_review 是复核桶，不等于 formal ready。
